exodus.32.p1.b1.text: Come, make us gods who will go before us. …

exodus.32.p1.b2.text: … As for this Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him!

exodus.32.p1.b3.text: Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.

exodus.32.p1.b4.text: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.

exodus.32.p2.b5.text: He took the gold from their hands, and with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf. …

exodus.32.p2.b6.text: Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.

exodus.32.p2.b7.text: These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

exodus.32.p2.b8.text: So the next day they arose, offered burnt offerings, and presented peace offerings. And the people sat down to eat and drink, and got up to indulge in revelry.

exodus.32.p3.b9.text: Go down at once, for your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves.

exodus.32.p3.b10.text: How quickly they have turned aside from the way that I commanded them! They have made for themselves a molten calf …

exodus.32.p3.b11.text: I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

exodus.32.p3.b12.text: Now leave Me alone, so that My anger may burn against them and consume them. Then I will make you into a great nation.”

exodus.32.p4.b13.text: O LORD, why does Your anger burn against Your people, …

exodus.32.p4.b14.text: … Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.

exodus.32.p4.b15.text: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, … I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky, …

exodus.32.p4.b16.text: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.

exodus.32.p5.b17.text: Then Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

exodus.32.p5.b18.text: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

exodus.32.p5.b19.text: The sound of war is in the camp.

exodus.32.p5.b20.text: It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!

exodus.32.p6.b21.text: As Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, …

exodus.32.p6.b22.text: … he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.

exodus.32.p7.b23.text: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder, …

exodus.32.p7.b24.text: … and scattered the powder over the face of the water. Then he forced the Israelites to drink it.

exodus.32.p7.b25.text: What did this people do to you, … that you have led them into so great a sin?

exodus.32.p7.b26.text: Do not be enraged, my lord, … You yourself know that the people are intent on evil.

exodus.32.p7.b27.text: … And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!

exodus.32.p8.b28.text: Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them run wild and become a laughingstock to their enemies.

exodus.32.p8.b29.text: Whoever is for the LORD, come to me.

exodus.32.p8.b30.text: And all the Levites gathered around him.

exodus.32.p8.b31.text: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people fell dead.

exodus.32.p9.b32.text: You have committed a great sin. Now I will go up to the LORD; perhaps I can make atonement for your sin.

exodus.32.p9.b33.text: So Moses returned to the LORD …

exodus.32.p9.b34.text: Oh, what a great sin these people have committed! They have made gods of gold for themselves.

exodus.32.p9.b35.text: Yet now, if You would only forgive their sin.... But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.”

exodus.32.p10.b36.text: Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.

exodus.32.p10.b37.text: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you. But on the day I settle accounts, I will punish them for their sin.”

exodus.32.p10.b38.text: And the LORD sent a plague on the people because of what they had done with the calf that Aaron had made.
